name: DirectoryListing::DirectoryListing (folder listing constructor; thiscall, ret 8: path, persist system or null)
notes: Lane IP. 0x3c bytes: std::vector<char> block, std::vector<const char*> entries, cursor, cRZString path. The path copied with a trailing separator added unless it ends in a backslash or slash; the cache key (0x8cf2e796, 0, StringKeyParser::Crc32(path, 1), 0) in the persist system default segment (primary slot 47; none for a null system); stamp = FolderStamp(path). With store and stamp: record slot 22 mode 1, the 4-byte stamp read, when equal the block resized to size-4+2 and read, accepted when the path slot 9 IsEqual(block, -1, 0) answers; Close, Release. Otherwise the folder scanned (0x1c48da/0x1c5896/0x1c5047/0x1c49eb, original callees): path, 0, then per entry (kind|0x80) name 0, then a final 0. The entry pointers parsed after the path string up to the empty string. With store, stamp and no cache hit: mode 2, Write(stamp,4) and Write(block); Close when both answer, else Abort; Release. Differential DirectoryListing_Construct, 1500 seeds: fake primary/store/record (each call answering or not, stored stamps equal or not, sizes 4..), scan stand-in with 0..12 seeded entries, FolderStamp stand-in on both sides, game operator new/delete redirected to ours; compared the call log, block bytes and capacity, entry offsets and capacity, cursor, path. Coverage: cached >= 50, scanned >= 300, written >= 200. Mutants (build/ip_mut.log, 15 over the class): 15/15 killed. Not yet run in-game. Lane LY: the directory scan is ours (src/rz/DirectoryScan.h: built and destroyed through its adapters, Scan and EntryAt as members); the test stands in for the image's and ours alike. Mutant (lane LY, switch): the scan built with its second flag set, killed by DirectoryListing_Construct.

notes: Lane IP.
